// PNEUMATIC ARMOR

DRYING ENGINEERING

ACTIVE ADSORPTION

Capturing water molecules at a microscopic level for ultra-dry air delivery — protecting brake valves and pneumatic actuators from moisture damage in all climates.

COALESCENCE

Integrated stage to separate oil aerosols from compressed airflow — neutralizing compressor carryover before it reaches sensitive ABS and brake control systems.

EXTENDED LIFESPAN

Reinforced structure withstands constant discharge and regeneration cycles — delivering extended service life and reduced maintenance intervals across fleet operations.

COLD WEATHER OPS

Prevents air line freezing in sub-zero environments — maintaining full pneumatic brake response and operational safety across arctic and high-altitude operations.

VALVE PROTECTION

Eliminates moisture-driven corrosion in brake valves and control units — ensuring rapid response times and maximum braking reliability in all conditions.

OEM INTEGRITY

Precision-matched to OEM specifications across 5,000+ cross-references — compatible with all major heavy-duty truck and bus platforms worldwide.
